sections.heading: Aamir Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Aamir Khan was born on 14 March 1965 in Mumbai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Tahir Hussain and his mother, Zeenat Hussain. He is a sibling of Faisal Khan, Nikhat Khan and Farhat Datta.
His listed education includes Bombay Scottish School, St. Anne's High School, Bandra and Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi, Urdu and English.
